calendarNotes: Fort Worth ISD’s 2026–27 traditional calendar starts August 10, 2026 and ends May 21, 2027. The amended PDF lists 175 student days, 78,750 instructional minutes, Fall Break on October 9, Thanksgiving Break from November 23–27, Winter Break from December 21 through January 1, a staff development day on January 4, spring break from March 15–19, Good Friday on March 26, and a staff development day on March 29.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Fort Worth ISD start and end school in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Fort Worth ISD’s traditional calendar starts Monday, August 10, 2026, and ends Friday, May 21, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fort Worth ISD spring break?
calendarFaqs.a: Fort Worth ISD’s spring break is March 15–19, 2027. Students return Monday, March 22.

calendarFaqs.q: Does this page cover every FWISD school?
calendarFaqs.a: No. This page covers the traditional districtwide calendar. FWISD also publishes separate ADSY, Early College High School at TCC, Alice Carlson ALC, and Jo Kelly calendars.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I find the official calendar PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the Official 2026–27 Calendar PDF link on this page, or check the Fort Worth ISD calendar page for the latest posted version.

calendarFaqs.q: Will the downloaded calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The ICS file is a one-time import, so later FWISD calendar revisions will not appear automatically.
School starts August 10 instead of August 12. The traditional calendar lists 175 student days instead of 173, and FWISD added Fall Break on October 9.

customSections.content: FWISD’s amended 2026–27 traditional calendar lists 175 student days and 78,750 instructional minutes. The changes below are the main differences families are likely to notice.

rows: School starts August 10 instead of August 12.
Back-to-school plans move two days earlier.
The calendar has 175 student days, up from 173.
The calendar includes two more student days and still ends May 21.
FWISD added Fall Break on October 9.
Students are off from Thursday, October 8, through Monday, October 12.
